questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Port of Spain?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Trinidad and Tobago is Port of Spain.

questions.prompt: True or false: “The capital city of Trinidad and Tobago is Montevideo.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Trinidad and Tobago article, or on the Atlas.

questions.proof: The capital city of Trinidad and Tobago is Port of Spain.

questions.prompt: Which continent is Trinidad and Tobago in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Trinidad and Tobago on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Trinidad and Tobago on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: Trinidad and Tobago is in North America.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Trinidad and Tobago?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Trinidad and Tobago is the Trinidad and Tobago dollar.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Trinidad and Tobago about 5,128 square kilometres; Federated States of Micronesia about 702 square kilometres; Saint Lucia about 617 square kilometres; Andorra about 468 square kilometres.

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia: Trinidad and Tobago
